services.name: Egypt Tours
services.desc: From the moment you step off the plane, Egypt will enchant you. Walk through the streets that have not changed much in hundreds of years and lose yourself in the bustling souks of Cairo, where you can buy everything from cardamom to carpets to camels. Feel the hot sun shining down, smell the incense and spices and listen to the calls to prayer booming from the mosques. You will be immersed in a culture that goes back to the beginning of civilization as you explore an ancient land that has likely never been described as dull. This Egypt vacation package is for those who want to spend as much time as possible, soaking up Egypt’s culture and history. This is one of our best-selling Egypt tours

blurb: Osiris Tours specializes in designing bespoke, guided tours and custom trips to Egypt, Morocco, Dubai, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Lebanon, and Turkey. Guests explore iconic sights, hidden gems, and exciting activities with luxurious accommodations and personalized service. Tours include visits to ancient monuments, cultural sites, and natural wonders with expert guides and private vehicles.

quotes.text: We booked a last-minute trip to Egypt with Osiris Tours and couldn't be happier. The custom itinerary, expert guides, and seamless logistics made every day unforgettable. From Cairo to Luxor, we felt safe, welcomed, and fully immersed in the adventure.
